column3: Detailed guide for optimizing database connection pool settings
column4: Connection pool optimization requires understanding workload patterns. Step 1: Measure peak concurrent connections needed. Step 2: Set minimum pool size to handle baseline load (typically 10-20). Step 3: Set maximum pool size based on database limits (usually 50-200). Step 4: Configure connection timeout to 30 seconds. Step 5: Set idle timeout to 10 minutes to reclaim unused connections. Step 6: Enable connection validation on borrow. Step 7: Monitor pool metrics continuously. Formula: max_pool_size = (peak_concurrent_users * queries_per_request) / avg_query_time_seconds
